detail:
Decisions: Chose to verify the rationale_source marker by reading exported record JSON rather than tool output — the presentation layer never renders the marker, so only the persisted record is decisive evidence; Chose to run the marker verification against the live plugin server instead of a local build
Findings: Sqlite backend is full-fidelity for decision records: the data column holds JSON.stringify of the whole Decision object (sqlite-stores.ts:178) and RecordExporter mirrors that same object, so exported JSON never drops fields like rationale_source on create or updateStatus round-trips
summary: Verified rationale_source marker persistence end-to-end: live twining_record through the plugin server, then asserted the marker in the exported record JSON
